interface.shortDescription: Open-source social media engine — 21 skills, asset-first compositing, AI image+video, 9-platform copy adaptation. Runs on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity.
interface.longDescription: 21 skills + 18 commands + 5 agents + 29 scripts + 12 opt-in MCP connectors. Asset-first compositing (brand assets are sacred, AI is the creative layer around them). AI image and AI video through the providers you hold keys for, with models resolved live rather than hardcoded; 9-platform copy adaptation (LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, Threads, Bluesky), human-in-the-loop review galleries, C2PA content provenance signing for EU AI Act Article 50. Portable across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Antigravity via the Agent Skills open standard.
defaultPrompt: Set up a new brand for social media production.
Index a brand's photo library so AI can match assets to upcoming posts.
Start a new monthly production cycle for the brand and generate all creative.
Build a review gallery so the client can approve creative before delivery.
